_comment: Companies co-founded by people who came through the AGI House / Genesis lineage. valuationB = most recent known valuation in USD billions (null = undisclosed, excluded from the total). The site sums valuationB client-side, so this file is the single source of truth for the headline number and the hover breakdown. Refreshed weekly by update-valuations (see newlander/README.md).

companies.note: $65B Series H closed May 2026 at $965B post-money (last priced round). Public S-1 filed Oct 26, 2026 (Nasdaq, ticker ANT); S-1/A filed Nov 2 still leaves share count and price range blank as of Nov 9, 2026. Bloomberg (Nov 6): prospective buyers discussing $1.2T-$1.3T after the AI stock selloff, down from $1.4T-$1.5T talk; Reuters (Nov 5): investors doubt a November listing. Roadshow cannot start before Nov 10. Unpriced, not counted.

Bloomberg (Nov 6, 2026): ~$11B first close of a new round at $1.25T wired to the company; remainder (up to ~$20B total, UAE investors incl. MGX and Coatue) expected over coming weeks. Reports differ on whether $1.25T is pre- or post-money. Scaled back from $30B at $1.4T target. Prior: $122B round closed Mar 2026 at $852B. Confidential S-1 filed Jun 2026; IPO targeted for 2027. John Schulman also a co-founder.

Series E-6 closed Jan 2026 at ~$22.6B per funding trackers (other trackers still show $20B, Sep 2025); Nvidia reportedly in talks (The Information, Aug 23, 2026) to invest at $30B+ — still not closed as of Nov 9, 2026, so not counted. Annualized revenue reportedly past $750M.

$2B seed, Jul 2025 ($12B post, last priced round). Nov 2025 talks at $50B+ collapsed by Jan 2026. Business Insider (Nov 6, 2026): set to close a ~$5B round led by Accel at $40B pre-money (~$45B post) as soon as this week; Nvidia reportedly ~$2.5B of it. Company declined to comment; not closed as of Nov 9, 2026, not counted. Co-founder Luke Metz reportedly returned to OpenAI; John Schulman also a co-founder.
$400M Series C closed Aug 12, 2026 at $13.3B, led by Menlo Ventures and EQT's Scaleup Europe Fund (Tencent, Balderton, Carmignac, Kaszek participating). Up from $6.6B Dec 2025.

$750M Series D led by Accel closed Oct 14, 2026 at $15.75B post-money (Kleiner Perkins joined; Menlo, General Catalyst, Redpoint, Lux, Bain Capital Ventures participated). Up from $4.65B Series C, May 2026. Company says annualized run rate passed $1B.
$650M raise from Nvidia and GV, May 2026.
Co-founded with Sam Altman. Parent Tools for Humanity valued ~$2.5B per Jun 2026 reports, down from $3B (2022).

Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to acquire Cresta on Nov 2, 2026 (price undisclosed by Salesforce); The Information reports ~$2.7B. Close expected in Salesforce FY2028 Q1 (early 2027). Prior mark: $1.6B Series C (2022), carried through Series D 2024. Hit $100M ARR Apr 2026 (Axios).

$1.37B Series D closed Aug 6, 2026 at $7.87B; anchored by JPMorgan's Strategic Investment Group, co-led by WCM, Washington Harbour, Valor, 137 Ventures, Baillie Gifford. Up from $1.6B in Jan 2026. Additional $360M debt facility Aug 14, 2026 (no valuation change).
Peak valuation; merged into Future (Jan 2025, terms undisclosed). Payne has since founded Coframe.
$243M Series C, Jul 2025.

Acquired by Nscale for $1.65B in Nscale equity (definitive agreement Jul 2026; price per Bloomberg and Nscale S-1). Closing is conditional on Nscale's IPO, still pending as of Nov 9, 2026 (S-1 filed Sep 18, 2026, NYSE ticker NSCL, no price range set; ~$30B target vs. investor push for $16B-$19B; reports in late Oct say listing slipped to at least Dec 2026). Prior mark: $1B Series C (2021).
Last disclosed 2025; $100M Series C, Feb 2026.
FutureHouse commercial spinout; $70M seed at $250M valuation, Dec 2025 (Spark Capital, Triatomic Capital).
Seed valuation, Sept 2020.
$15M seed at $100M post-money announced Jul 20, 2026 (Touring Capital, Principal Venture Partners).
Reported ~$20M seed; valuation not disclosed. Paused since Karpathy joined Anthropic's pre-training team on May 19, 2026.
$9.3M seed; acquired HaystacksAI Mar 2026; valuation not disclosed.
Formerly Cradle; $58M Series A, Sept 2025.
~$15M raised; valuation not disclosed.
$23M Series B, Jul 2025; valuation not disclosed.
AI investor lab; valuation not disclosed.
Reportedly in talks (Nov 2025) to raise $50M at a $500M valuation; unconfirmed/not closed. Secondary report (Apr 2026) of an $8M seed for on-device agents; valuation not disclosed. Formerly MultiOn.
$1.6M raised (led by Pioneer); valuation not disclosed.
Brain-emulation startup; $3.5M seed led by Protocol Labs, 2024; valuation not disclosed.

$15M seed led by Lightspeed (closed Sept 2025, announced Dec 2025) at $97.5M post-money per PitchBook. $35M Series A led by CRV announced Sep 16, 2026 (Axios), total raised $50M; Series A valuation not disclosed, so prior mark kept. Co-founders Zubin Koticha and Alexis Gauba.
